g.title: Add pylib-agent-benchmarking skill with in-skill tf_gnns benchmarks

Make tf_gnns agent benchmarks pass by improving user docs
Benchmarks now pass 8/8 under ollama/qwen3.8 with the packaged tf-gnns-user-docs skill. The main changes:
- Expand agent_skill references: multi-graph batching, subgraph extraction with edge_trimming_mode, assign_global check_shape, GraphNetMLP with globals and explicit sizes, factory config with composite aggregation and eval_tensor_dict/graph_tuple_eval parity, SparseGCN edge weights and dtypes, documented GCNv2 ValueError boundaries. - Add Environment/Agent Workflow guidance to SKILL.md so agents use the uv project env and the docs tool instead of probing the environment or reading library source. - Tighten the suite agent_prompt (read the matching topic, write the solution immediately, avoid env spelunking) and raise task timeouts to 600s. - Run validation commands with uv run python; add agent_docs CLI, API index generator, docs tests, and lazy package-root exports. - Ignore agent_benchmark_results/.
Add authoritative API signatures and output contracts to tf_gnns user docs
added also the metaskill for the agent documentation
Fix graph-indep benchmark prompt to use the actual GraphIndep API (no create_global_function kwarg)

Add Core 6 benchmarks and fix doc examples
- Add 6 new task YAMLs (09-14): factory-direct-uses, aggregation-modes, save-load-roundtrip, configurations-recurrent-residual, data-semantics, gcn-training-mode-forward. - graphnets.md: fix GNCellMLP example (int units, call before inspecting all_weights), add graph_eval globals caveat and list-units warning. - graphs.md: replace broken GraphTuple.is_equal_by_value with field-wise comparison; add -from+to / is_equal_by_value boundary notes. - backends.md: fix tf.concat axis and tf.is_finite for TF 2.21. - Regenerate api_index.json.

Restructure agent docs concept-first; fix GraphNetMLP global contract; shift benchmark params
Concept-first topic pages: every reference page now leads with How It Works, Decision Guide, Parameter Key Facts, Boundaries & Gotchas, and a Minimal Skeleton before Rules/API Signatures/Output Contract, with examples moved to a final Example Gallery. Agent_docs gains a --concepts extraction mode and the SKILL.md and benchmark suite agent_prompt now direct agents to read concepts first and treat examples as reference, not templates.
Docs accuracy fixes: GraphNetMLP always builds a global block and fails without global_attr + repetition keys (verified against models/ graphnet.py); the no-global path is GraphNetMPNN_MLP only. Example Gallery now shows reading object-graph edge widths via edge_tensor.
API index: generator now unions root and submodule __all__ but keeps a submodule name only when the reference docs mention it (GCNv2 added, maybe_patch_ld_library_path_for_tensorflow excluded), and filters underscore-prefixed names.
Benchmark shifts: tasks 09-14 parametrize so copy-pasting doc examples fails (units/widths/cores/reps/training paths all diverge from the docs). Trace rules flag examples-before-concepts retrieval and /tmp probe scripts. New reference solutions verified for all six shifted tasks.

Fix trace rule: flag genuine agent_docs --examples executions
The old regex matched SKILL.md's own last-resort --examples mention inside skill-tool output, so it fired on every run. Require the bash tool JSON "command" context so it only fires on real executions.
added an index creation step before running the tests (tests also check for agent skill and require the index to be available)

Merge pull request #10 from mylonasc/agentic-doc-metaskill
Agentic doc metaskill - the library packages a skill that can be used to help coding agents make effective use of the library with fewer tokens. It also contains a skill that helps with benchmarking token efficiency when using the coding skill.
